496    # Receives an "allocate-task" -> due to being broken or incapable -> this is the side receiving the help request
497    class ReceiveAllocatationBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
498        """Handles incoming 'allocate-task' messages, taking over collections from failing or incapable peer trucks."""
499        async def run(self):
500            """Checks if capable of handling the allocated task and attempts to claim it."""
501            msg = await self.receive(timeout = 1)
502            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "allocate-task":
503                bin_pos = tuple(map(int, msg.body.split(","))) # problematic bin position
504                bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(bin_pos)
505                
506                # Check waste type compatibility
507                if bin and not self.agent.is_waste_type_compatible(bin.waste_type):
508                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Rejecting allocation for {bin.waste_type} bin at ({bin_pos[1]},{bin_pos[0]}) - incompatible types")
509                    return
510                
511                # if it passes here, it means it can take the job
512                if not self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.emergency and not self.agent.is_broken and not bin_pos in self.agent.no_path:
513                    if (self.agent.exploration_bin != None): # release the bin it was exploring, sends release-bin message
514                        await self.send_release_message(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
515                    self.agent.current_path = None
516                    self.agent.exploration_bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(bin_pos)
517                    self.agent.where = "bin"
518                    self.agent.is_busy = True # sets new target bin and indicates it is busy
519                    for truck in self.agent.get_same_type_trucks():
520                        await self.warn_bin(bin_pos) # warns the bin that someone is coming to resolve the problem, activates "ReceiveProblemResolveBehaviour" in the bin which stops asking for help
521                        await self.prepare_proposal(truck.jid, bin_pos) # sends a claim bin
522                    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Waits for responses
523                    if bin_pos not in self.agent.not_accessible_bins: # if no one else claims the same bin (not in non-accessibles) then the truck officially assumes the task
524                        print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Selected bin at ({bin_pos[1]},{bin_pos[0]}) for resolve ALLOCATION problem.")
525                        _, self.agent.current_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin_pos)
526                        self.agent.collab += 1
527
528        # Send release message to all trucks of the same type
529        async def send_release_message(self, bin_position):
530            """
531            Send a 'release-bin' message to peers when cancelling the current exploration target.
532            
533            Args:
534                bin_position (tuple): The position (row, col) of the bin being released.
535            """
536            release_msg = Message()
537            release_msg.set_metadata("performative", "release-bin")
538            release_msg.body = f"{bin_position[0]},{bin_position[1]}"
539            for truck in self.agent.get_same_type_trucks():
540                release_msg.to = str(truck.jid)
541                await self.send(release_msg)
542            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Sent release message for bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}).")
543
544        async def warn_bin(self, pos):
545            """
546            Send a 'resolve-problem' message to the bin, confirming a truck is taking over.
547            
548            Args:
549                pos (tuple): Position of the bin to warn (row, col).
550            """
551            warn_msg = Message()
552            warn_msg.set_metadata("performative", "resolve-problem")
553            bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(pos)
554            warn_msg.to = str(bin.jid)

558        async def prepare_proposal(self, truck_name, bin_pos):
559            """Send a 'claim-bin' message to peer trucks to claim the allocated task."""
560            cost, _ = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin_pos)
561            proposal = Message()
562            proposal.set_metadata("performative", "claim-bin")
563            proposal.body = f"{bin_pos[0]},{bin_pos[1]},{cost},{self.agent.fuel},{self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load},{self.agent.truck_type}"
564            proposal.to = str(truck_name)
565            await self.send(proposal)
566            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Truck sent ALLOCATION claim bin at {bin_pos} with cost {cost}.")

569    class ReceiveReleaseBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
570        """ Handles incoming 'release-bin' messages from peers."""
571        async def run(self):
572            """Removes the released bin from the list of non-accessible bins, making it available again."""
573            msg = await self.receive(timeout = 1)
574            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "release-bin":
575                released_bin = tuple(map(int, msg.body.split(",")))
576                # if it was in non-accessible bins, remove it
577                if released_bin in self.agent.not_accessible_bins:
578                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.remove(released_bin)

581    class ReceiveDeclineClaimBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
582        """Handles 'decline-claim' messages, yielding the contested bin."""
583        async def run(self):
584            """If the bin being claimed by this agent is declined, the agent resets its state and marks the bin as inaccessible."""
585            msg = await self.receive(timeout=1)
586            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "decline-claim":
587                bin_position = tuple(map(int, msg.body.split(",")[:2]))
588                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Received decline-claim for bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}) from [{msg.sender}].")
589                if self.agent.exploration_bin != None and self.agent.exploration_bin.position == bin_position:
590                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
591                    self.agent.where = None
592                    self.agent.current_path = None
593                    self.agent.is_busy = False
594                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Released bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}) after decline-claim.")
595                self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(bin_position)

597    # self-monitoring behavior
598    class CheckStatusBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour): 
599        """Monitors the truck's fuel and load status for emergency returns."""
600        async def run(self):
601            """Checks for low fuel or full load (90%) and triggers an emergency return to central."""
602            if not self.agent.emergency and not self.agent.is_broken:
603                if not self.agent.has_enough_fuel(): # if it has less fuel than cost to central
604                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Low fuel. Returning to central.")
605                    self.agent.is_busy = True
606                    self.agent.emergency = True
607                    if (self.agent.exploration_bin != None): # if it has an associated bin, sends release
608                        self.send_release_message(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
609                        self.agent.exploration_bin = None
610                        self.agent.where = None 
611                        self.agent.current_path = None
612                    await self.return_to_central()
613                elif self.agent.is_full(): # if load is full (90%)
614                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Full load. Returning to central.")
615                    self.agent.is_busy = True
616                    self.agent.emergency = True
617                    if (self.agent.exploration_bin != None): # if it has an associated bin, sends release
618                        self.send_release_message(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
619                        self.agent.exploration_bin = None
620                        self.agent.where = None
621                        self.agent.current_path = None
622                    await self.return_to_central()

627            _, self.agent.current_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(self.agent.environment.central)
628            self.agent.where = 'central'

646    def has_enough_fuel(self):
647        """
648        Check if the truck has sufficient fuel to reach the central station.
649
650        Returns:
651            bool: True if fuel is greater than the cost to the central, False otherwise.
652        """
653        cost, _ = self.get_shortest_path(self.environment.central)
654        return self.fuel > cost

656    def is_full(self):
657        """
658        Check if the truck's load is 90% or more of its maximum capacity.
659
660        Returns:
661            bool: True if the truck is nearly full, False otherwise.
662        """
663        return self.load >= 0.9 * self.max_load

665    class MoveToBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
666        """Handles the physical movement of the truck along its planned path."""
667        async def run(self):
668            """Moves the truck one step along the path, consumes fuel, and handles environmental changes."""
669            # in each iteration, checks truck state
670            if self.agent.changes == True: # if changed, meaning environment updated somehow, checks if route needs changing
671                await self.receive_environment_update()
672            elif self.agent.is_broken == True: # if broken down
673                await self.broke_down()
674            else: # if not broken and environment didn't change
675                if self.agent.current_path != None:
676                    if self.agent.current_path == None:
677                        return
678                    path = self.agent.current_path
679                    if len(self.agent.current_path) != 1:
680                        curr_node_name = path[0] # truck moves from node to node
681                        next_node_name = path[1]
682                        next_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(next_node_name)
683                        self.agent.environment.move_truck(self, next_pos)
684                        edge_data = self.agent.environment.g.get_edge_data(curr_node_name, next_node_name)
685                        w_edge = edge_data["weight"] # consumes fuel
686                        self.agent.fuel -= w_edge
687                        self.agent.total_fuel += w_edge
688                        self.agent.total_distance += 1
689                        await asyncio.sleep(w_edge) # simulates physical travel time
690                        if self.agent.current_path != None and len(self.agent.current_path) != 1 and next_node_name == self.agent.current_path[1]:
691                            self.agent.current_path = self.agent.current_path[1:] # cuts the node representing where the truck just left
692                            print("cut path")
693                    else:
694                        print("Chegou ao destino") # if path has only 1 node
695                        if self.agent.where == 'bin': # if destination is a bin
696                            print("vai coletar lixo?")
697                            await self.collect_waste() # collects waste
698                            self.agent.current_path = None
699                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
700                            self.agent.where = None
701                            self.agent.is_busy = False
702                        elif self.agent.where == 'central': # if destination is central
703                            print("vai dar refill?")
704                            await self.refill()
705                            self.agent.current_path = None
706                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
707                            self.agent.where = None
708                            self.agent.is_busy = False
709        
710        async def receive_environment_update(self):
711            """Handles changes in the environment (e.g., traffic or roadblocks)."""
712            # Reset change flag
713            self.agent.changes = False
714
715            # Checks if previously inaccessible bins now have a path
716            for bin_pos in list(self.agent.no_path):
717                try:
718                    _, p = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin_pos)
719                    self.agent.no_path.remove(bin_pos)
720                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.remove(bin_pos)
721                except Exception:
722                    pass  # still no path
723
724            # Recalculates current path with updated traffic
725            if hasattr(self.agent, "current_target") and self.agent.current_target is not None:
726                try:
727                    _, new_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(self.agent.current_target)
728                    self.agent.current_path = new_path
729                except Exception:
730                    pass  # if fails, keeps old path
731
732                    
733                    # Check if truck's current path is still valid
734                    if self.agent.current_path != None: # current_path is the truck's path in the graph (a list of nodes)
735                        path = self.agent.current_path
736                        self.agent.current_path = None
737                        final_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(path[-1]) # path[-1] is the last node (the bin)
738                        try: # tries to recalculate path to destination
739                            _, new_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(final_pos) # if successful, replaces old path
740                            self.agent.current_path = new_path
741                        except Exception as e: # if path to destination no longer exists
742                                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Mudanças na estrada. Já não exite caminho para o bin em ({final_pos[1]},{final_pos[0]})")
743                                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
744                                    self.agent.where = None
745                                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(final_pos)
746                                    self.agent.no_path.append(final_pos)
747                                    self.agent.current_path = None
748                                    self.agent.is_busy = False
749                                    # Now we must tell the bin I am not coming
750                                    await self.warn_bin(final_pos)
751        
752        async def warn_bin(self, pos):
753            """
754            Sends a 'problem' message to the target bin when the path is lost due to environment changes.
755            
756            Args:
757                pos (tuple): Position of the bin to warn (row, col).
758            """
759            warn_msg = Message()
760            warn_msg.set_metadata("performative", "problem")
761            bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(pos)
762            warn_msg.to = str(bin.jid)
763            await self.send(warn_msg)
764            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Can't go to bin ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}). Bin warned.")

766        async def collect_waste(self):
767            """Simulates waste collection, updating truck load and bin waste level."""
768            bin_at_position = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(self.agent.position)
769            if bin_at_position:
770                load_to_collect = min(bin_at_position.current_waste, self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load)
771                self.agent.load += load_to_collect
772                self.agent.collected_waste += load_to_collect
773                bin_at_position.current_waste -= load_to_collect
774                bin_at_position.is_waiting_for_truck = False
775                
776                # Ensure the bin knows this is an exploration collection if it wasn't by CFP
777                if bin_at_position.last_collection_type != 'cfp':
778                    bin_at_position.last_collection_type = 'autonomous'
779                
780                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Truck collected {load_to_collect} waste. Current load: {self.agent.load}/{self.agent.max_load}.")
781                await self.send_release_message(bin_at_position.position)
782            else:
783                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] No bin found at the current position.")
784                
785        async def refill(self):
786            """Simulates refuelling and unloading the waste load at the central station."""
787            self.agent.fuel = self.agent.max_fuel  # Simulates refueling
788            self.agent.load = 0  # Simulates waste unloading
789            await asyncio.sleep(5)
790            self.agent.is_busy = False
791            self.agent.emergency = False # becomes ready for new tasks
792            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Refilled and unloaded at central.")
793
794        async def broke_down(self):
795            """ Handles the truck breaking down, releasing the bin and entering a waiting state."""
796            if (self.agent.is_broken):  
797                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] is broken")   
798                if self.agent.current_path != None:   
799                    bin_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(self.agent.current_path[-1])
800                    await self.send_release_message(bin_pos)
801                    if (self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.emergency and self.agent.exploration_bin != None):
802                        print("Estava busy,  alocar outros trucks")
803                        await self.warn_bin(bin_pos)
804                        await self.alocate_others_trucks(bin_pos)
805                        
806                self.agent.exploration_bin = None
807                self.agent.current_path = None
808                self.agent.where = None
809                
810                # Time the truck will stay non-functional
811                broken_time = 10
812                for i in range (broken_time):
813                    await asyncio.sleep(1)
814                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] {broken_time-i} seconds left until normal functionning")
815                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] normal functioning started") # back to normal
816                
817                self.agent.emergency = False
818                self.agent.is_broken = False
819                self.agent.is_busy = False

853    class Help(CyclicBehaviour):
854        """ Safety mechanism to detect if the truck is stuck or blocked.
855        
856        If the truck is busy but stationary for too long (5s), it releases the bin, 
857        sends a warning to peer trucks, and becomes available again.
858        """
859        async def run(self):      
860            """Monitors truck position over time and triggers alert if the truck is blocked while busy."""                                                              
861            # Help only acts if truck is busy and not broken...
862            if self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.is_broken:
863                start_pos = self.agent.position
864                start_time = self.agent.environment.timer()
865
866                # Waits 5 time units (simulates periodic monitoring)
867                await asyncio.sleep(5)
868                new_time = self.agent.environment.timer()
869
870                # If enough time passed and truck didn't move -> blocked
871                if new_time - start_time >= 5 and self.agent.position == start_pos:
872                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] parece estar preso. Ativando HELP...")
873
874                    # If associated with a bin, notifies and releases
875                    if self.agent.exploration_bin is not None:
876                        await self.warn_bin(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
877                        await self.send_release_message(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
878                        print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] liberou o bin e enviou alerta.")
879
880                    # Reset dos estados principais
881                    self.agent.is_busy = False
882                    self.agent.current_path = None
883                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
884                    self.agent.where = None
885
886                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] ready for new tasks after HELP.")
887

921    async def setup(self):
922        """Sets up all initial behaviours for the TruckAgent upon startup."""
923        self.add_behaviour(self.ReceiveCFPBehaviour())
924        self.add_behaviour(self.ReceiveAcceptanceBehaviour())
925        self.add_behaviour(self.ExploreEnvironmentBehaviour())
926        self.add_behaviour(self.ReceiveClaimBehaviour())
927        self.add_behaviour(self.ReceiveReleaseBehaviour())
928        self.add_behaviour(self.ReceiveDeclineClaimBehaviour())
929        self.add_behaviour(self.CheckStatusBehaviour())
930        self.add_behaviour(self.MoveToBehaviour())
931        self.add_behaviour(self.ReceiveAllocatationBehaviour())
932        self.add_behaviour(self.Help())
933        print(f"[{self.name}] [{self.truck_type}] Truck agent {str(self.jid)} has initialized.")

An autonomous agent representing a waste collection truck.

Attributes: environment (Environment): Reference to the simulation environment.
truck_type (str): The type of waste the truck collects ("organic" or "recyclable").
load (int): Current waste load in the truck.
max_load (int): Maximum waste capacity of the truck.
fuel (int): Current fuel level.
max_fuel (int): Maximum fuel capacity.
position (tuple): Current grid coordinates (row, col).

is_broken (bool): True if the truck has broken down and is temporarily unavailable.
collected_waste (int): Total waste collected over the simulation.
total_fuel (int): Total fuel consumed over the simulation.
total_distance (int): Total distance traveled (sum of edge weights).
collab (int): Number of times the truck was involved in collaboration (negotiation or allocation).

def get_shortest_path(self, new_position): 
184    def get_shortest_path(self, new_position):
185        """
186        Calculate the shortest path and its cost from the truck's current position 
187        to a target position using Dijkstra's algorithm.
188
189        Args:
190            new_position (tuple): The target position (row, col).
191
192        Returns:
193            tuple: (cost, path), where cost is the length (weight sum) and path is a list of node names.
194        """
195        source_node = self.environment.node_name_template(self.position[0], self.position[1])
196        target_node = self.environment.node_name_template(new_position[0], new_position[1])
197
198        # path is calculated with the weight attribute of the edges, it includes the source and the target
199        path = nx.shortest_path(self.environment.g, source=source_node, target=target_node, method='dijkstra',weight='weight')
200        cost = nx.shortest_path_length(self.environment.g, source=source_node, target=target_node, method='dijkstra',weight='weight')
201        return (cost, path)

Calculate the shortest path and its cost from the truck's current position to a target position using Dijkstra's algorithm.

Args: new_position (tuple): The target position (row, col).

Returns: tuple: (cost, path), where cost is the length (weight sum) and path is a list of node names.

def get_cost(self, begin, end): 
204    def get_cost(self, begin, end):
205        """
206        Calculate the cost (weighted distance) between two points.
207
208        Args:
209            begin (tuple): Starting position (row, col).        
210            end (tuple): Ending position (row, col).
211
212        Returns:
213            int: The shortest path cost.
214        """
215        source_node = self.environment.node_name_template(begin[0], begin[1])
216        target_node = self.environment.node_name_template(end[0], end[1])
217        cost = nx.shortest_path_length(self.environment.g, source=source_node, target=target_node, method='dijkstra',weight='weight')
218        return cost

Calculate the cost (weighted distance) between two points.

Args: begin (tuple): Starting position (row, col).
end (tuple): Ending position (row, col).

Returns: int: The shortest path cost.

646    def has_enough_fuel(self):
647        """
648        Check if the truck has sufficient fuel to reach the central station.
649
650        Returns:
651            bool: True if fuel is greater than the cost to the central, False otherwise.
652        """
653        cost, _ = self.get_shortest_path(self.environment.central)
654        return self.fuel > cost

Check if the truck has sufficient fuel to reach the central station.

657        """
658        Check if the truck's load is 90% or more of its maximum capacity.
659

662        """

class TruckAgent.ReceiveCFPBehaviour(spade.behaviour.CyclicBehaviour): 
 92    class ReceiveCFPBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
 93        """
 94        Cyclic Behaviour: Acts as the "Contractor" in CNP, listening for CFP messages.
 95        """
 96        async def run(self):
 97            """
 98            Receives CFP, checks compatibility, calculates cost/path, and sends PROPOSE or DECLINE.
 99            """
100            msg = await self.receive(timeout=1)
101            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "cfp":
102                # Parse bin position and waste type from message body
103                parts = msg.body.split(",")
104                row, col = map(int, parts[:2])
105                bin_waste_type = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "generic"
106                bin_location = (row, col)
107                
108                print(f"📨 [{self.agent.name}] Received CFP from {bin_waste_type} bin at ({col},{row})")
109                
110                # Check waste type compatibility first
111                if not self.agent.is_waste_type_compatible(bin_waste_type):
112                    print(f"❌ [{self.agent.name}] Incompatible with {bin_waste_type} bin at ({col},{row})")
113                    await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
114                    return
115                    
116                if self.agent.is_busy or self.agent.is_broken:
117                    print(f"❌ [{self.agent.name}] Busy or broken, rejecting CFP")
118                    await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
119                    return
120                
121                # Check if nodes exist in graph
122                source_node = self.agent.environment.node_name_template(self.agent.position[0], self.agent.position[1])
123                target_node = self.agent.environment.node_name_template(bin_location[0], bin_location[1])
124                
125                if source_node not in self.agent.environment.g:
126                    print(f"❌ [{self.agent.name}] Source node {source_node} not in graph")
127                    await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
128                    return
129                    
130                if target_node not in self.agent.environment.g:
131                    print(f"❌ [{self.agent.name}] Target node {target_node} not in graph")
132                    await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
133                    return
134                
135                # check if it possible to get to the bin
136                try:
137                    if not nx.has_path(self.agent.environment.g, source_node, target_node):
138                        print(f"❌ [{self.agent.name}] No path to bin at ({col},{row})")
139                        if bin_location not in self.agent.no_path:
140                            self.agent.no_path.append(bin_location)
141                            self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(bin_location)
142                        await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
143                    else:
144                        is_possible = self.agent.get_cost(self.agent.position, bin_location) + self.agent.get_cost(bin_location, self.agent.environment.central)
145                        if is_possible < self.agent.fuel and not self.agent.is_busy:
146                            await self.prepare_proposal(bin_location, msg.sender, bin_waste_type)
147                        else:
148                            await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
149                except Exception as e:
150                    print(f"❌ [{self.agent.name}] Error checking path: {e}")
151                    await self.decline_proposal(msg.sender)
152        
153        async def decline_proposal(self, bin_jid):
154            """
155            Send a DECLINE message to the bin's agent.
156
157            Args:
158                bin_jid (str): The JID of the bin agent that sent the CFP.
159            """
160            decline_msg = Message(to = str(bin_jid))
161            decline_msg.set_metadata("performative", "decline")
162            decline_msg.body = "Truck is busy"
163            await self.send(decline_msg)
164            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Truck rejected the request from {bin_jid} (busy).")
165    
166        async def prepare_proposal(self, bin_position, bin_jid, bin_waste_type):
167            """
168            Calculate cost and send a PROPOSE message to the bin.
169
170            Args:
171                bin_position (tuple): The (row, col) of the bin.        
172                bin_jid (str): The JID of the bin agent.        
173                bin_waste_type (str): The type of waste the bin requested.      
174            """
175            estimated_cost, best_route = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin_position)
176            proposal = Message(to = str(bin_jid))
177            proposal.set_metadata("performative", "propose")
178            # Include truck type in the proposal
179            proposal.body = f"{best_route};{estimated_cost};{self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load};{self.agent.fuel};{self.agent.truck_type}"
180            await self.send(proposal)
181            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Truck sent proposal to {bin_waste_type} bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}) with cost {estimated_cost}.")

Cyclic Behaviour: Acts as the "Contractor" in CNP, listening for CFP messages.

class TruckAgent.ReceiveAcceptanceBehaviour(spade.behaviour.CyclicBehaviour): 
221    class ReceiveAcceptanceBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour): 
222        """Cyclic Behaviour: Implements the "Contract Winner" logic, reacting to ACCEPT messages."""
223        async def run(self):
224            """Handles ACCEPT message: sets the path, marks busy, and possibly cancels exploration."""
225            msg = await self.receive(timeout = 1)
226            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "accept":
227                if not self.agent.is_broken and not self.agent.emergency and not self.agent.is_busy:
228                    # If an accept message is received, cancel the exploration
229                    if self.agent.exploration_bin != None:
230                        await self.send_release_message(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
231                    self.agent.is_busy = True
232                    self.agent.current_path = ast.literal_eval(msg.body)
233                    bin_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(self.agent.current_path[-1])
234                    bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(bin_pos)
235                    self.agent.exploration_bin = bin
236                    self.agent.where = "bin"
237                    
238                    # MARKS ON THE BIN THAT THIS COLLECTION IS BY CFP
239                    if bin:
240                        bin.last_collection_type = 'cfp'
241                    
242                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Received accept message of CFP. Moving to assigned bin.")
243                    #await self.send_claim_message(bin, self.agent.get_cost(self.agent.position, bin_pos))
244                else: # if it cannot accept (e.g., broken)
245                    path = ast.literal_eval(msg.body)
246                    pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(path[-1])
247                    await self.warn_bin(pos) # warns the bin
248                    await self.alocate_others_trucks(pos) 
249
250    # the bin gets to know the chosen truck cannot come -> bin acts with "ReceiveProblemBehaviour"
251        async def warn_bin(self, pos):
252            """
253            Send a 'problem' message to the bin, informing it of failure (e.g., breakdown).
254
255            Args:
256                pos (tuple): Position of the bin to warn (row, col).
257            """
258            warn_msg = Message()
259            warn_msg.set_metadata("performative", "problem")
260            bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(pos)
261            warn_msg.to = str(bin.jid)
262            await self.send(warn_msg)
263            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Can't go to bin ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}). Bin warned.")
264
265        # "I cannot collect waste from bin (x,y). Can any other truck take the task for me?"
266        async def alocate_others_trucks(self, bin_position):
267            """
268            Send an 'allocate-task' message to compatible peer trucks, asking for assistance.
269
270            Args:
271                bin_position (tuple): Position of the bin that needs collection (row, col).
272            """
273            print("Entrou em alocate")
274            allocate_task_msg = Message()
275            allocate_task_msg.set_metadata("performative", "allocate-task") # allocates task to another truck here
276            allocate_task_msg.body=f"{bin_position[0]},{bin_position[1]}"
277            # Only send to trucks of the same type
278            for truck in self.agent.get_same_type_trucks():
279                allocate_task_msg.to = str(truck.jid)
280                await self.send(allocate_task_msg)
281                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Asking [{allocate_task_msg.to}] to go to the bin ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}).")
282        
283        # Send claim message to all trucks of the same type
284        async def send_claim_message(self, bin, cost):
285            """
286            Send a 'claim-bin' message to peer trucks after a successful CNP acceptance.
287            
288            Args:
289                bin (BinAgent): The bin agent being claimed.        
290                cost (int): The cost (weighted distance) to reach the bin.
291            """
292            claim_msg = Message()
293            claim_msg.set_metadata("performative", "claim-bin")
294            claim_msg.body = f"{bin.position[0]},{bin.position[1]},{cost},{self.agent.fuel},{self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load},{self.agent.truck_type}"
295            for truck in self.agent.get_same_type_trucks():
296                claim_msg.to = str(truck.jid)
297                await self.send(claim_msg)
298                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Sent claim message for bin at ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}) to {truck.jid} due to CFP acceptance.")
299
300        # Send release message to all trucks of the same type
301        async def send_release_message(self, bin_position):
302            """
303            Send a 'release-bin' message to peer trucks, typically when cancelling a collection.
304            
305            Args:
306                bin_position (tuple): The position (row, col) of the bin being released.
307            """
308            release_msg = Message()
309            release_msg.set_metadata("performative", "release-bin")
310            release_msg.body = f"{bin_position[0]},{bin_position[1]}"
311            for truck in self.agent.get_same_type_trucks():
312                release_msg.to = str(truck.jid)
313                await self.send(release_msg)
314            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Sent release message for bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}).")

317    class ExploreEnvironmentBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
318        """Implements the truck's autonomous and proactive exploration logic. """
319        async def run(self):
320            """Searches for bins and attempts to claim the best one for autonomous collection."""
321            if not self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.emergency and not self.agent.is_broken and self.agent.exploration_bin == None: # when the truck is free
322                self.agent.current_path = None
323                nearby_bins = self.agent.environment.get_nearby_bins(self.agent.position) # looks for nearby bins
324                for bin in nearby_bins: # for each nearby bin
325                    # Check waste type compatibility
326                    if not self.agent.is_waste_type_compatible(bin.waste_type):
327                        continue
328                        
329                    if bin.position not in self.agent.not_accessible_bins and not self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.is_broken:
330                        try: 
331                            cost, path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin.position) # calculates the path
332                            self.agent.exploration_bin = bin
333                            self.agent.where = 'bin'
334                            if (not self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.is_broken):
335                                await self.send_claim_message(bin, cost) # sends claim bin
336                                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Waiting for responses after claiming {bin.waste_type} bin at ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}) for EXPLORATION.")
337                                await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Waits for responses
338                            if not self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.emergency and not self.agent.is_broken and bin.position not in self.agent.not_accessible_bins:
339                                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Selected {bin.waste_type} bin at ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}) for exploration.")
340                                
341                                # MARKS ON THE BIN THAT THIS COLLECTION IS AUTONOMOUS
342                                bin.last_collection_type = 'autonomous'
343                                
344                                self.agent.current_path = path
345                                break
346
347                            else:
348                                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] {bin.waste_type} bin at ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}) was declined for exploration.") # otherwise, gives up and tries another
349                                if not self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.emergency:
350                                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
351                                    self.agent.where = None
352                                    self.agent.current_path = None
353                                break
354                        except Exception as e:
355                            print(f"[{self.agent}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Não exite caminho para o {bin.waste_type} bin ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]})")
356                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
357                            self.agent.where = None
358                            self.agent.current_path = None
359                            self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(bin.position)
360                            self.agent.no_path.append(bin.position)
361                                
362        async def send_claim_message(self, bin, cost):
363            """
364            Send a 'claim-bin' message to all trucks of the same type during autonomous exploration.
365
366            Args:
367                bin (BinAgent): The bin agent being claimed.        
368                cost (int): The cost to reach the bin.
369            """
370            claim_msg = Message()
371            claim_msg.set_metadata("performative", "claim-bin")
372            claim_msg.body = f"{bin.position[0]},{bin.position[1]},{cost},{self.agent.fuel},{self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load},{self.agent.truck_type}"
373            for truck in self.agent.get_same_type_trucks():
374                claim_msg.to = str(truck.jid)
375                await self.send(claim_msg)
376                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Sent claim message for {bin.waste_type} bin at ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}) to {truck.jid} due to EXPLORATION.")

class TruckAgent.ReceiveClaimBehaviour(spade.behaviour.CyclicBehaviour): 
379    class ReceiveClaimBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
380        """Handles incoming 'claim-bin' messages from peers to prevent redundant collections."""
381        async def run(self):
382            """Negotiates claims based on capacity, cost, fuel, and ID."""
383            msg = await self.receive(timeout=1)
384            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "claim-bin" and not self.agent.is_broken and not self.agent.emergency:
385                bin_data = msg.body.split(",")
386                bin_position = (int(bin_data[0]), int(bin_data[1]))
387                other_cost = int(bin_data[2])
388                other_fuel = int(bin_data[3])
389                other_capacity = int(bin_data[4])
390                other_truck_type = bin_data[5] if len(bin_data) > 5 else "organic"
391                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] recebeu claim-bin de [{msg.sender}] ({other_truck_type})")
392
393                # Only respond to trucks of the same type
394                if other_truck_type != self.agent.truck_type:
395                    return
396
397                # Case 1: this truck also has the same bin as target and is already working on it (is_busy) 
398                if self.agent.exploration_bin != None and self.agent.exploration_bin.position == bin_position and self.agent.is_busy:
399                    confirm_msg = Message(to=str(msg.sender))
400                    confirm_msg.set_metadata("performative", "decline-claim") # message "this bin is mine, I am coming to get it"
401                    confirm_msg.body = f"{bin_position[0]},{bin_position[1]}"
402                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Warning other truck {msg.sender} to realise claim for bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}). (My bin)")
403                    await self.send(confirm_msg)
404                
405                # Case 2: they want the same bin but this truck is free
406                elif self.agent.exploration_bin != None and self.agent.exploration_bin.position == bin_position and not self.agent.is_broken and not self.agent.is_busy:
407                    self.agent.collab += 1
408                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] avaliando...")
409                    my_cost = self.agent.get_cost(self.agent.position, bin_position) # calculates cost
410                    my_fuel = self.agent.fuel # fuel
411                    my_capacity = self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load # capacity
412
413                    # Deterministic negotiation logic
414                    my_id = self.agent.jid
415                    other_id = str(msg.sender)
416                    negotiate = self.evaluate_negotiation( # compare both trucks
417                        my_cost, other_cost, my_fuel, other_fuel,
418                        my_capacity, other_capacity,
419                        my_id, other_id
420                    )
421
422                    if negotiate:  # Other truck is better and will win, this one gives up the bin
423                        print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Realise claim for bin ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}) to {msg.sender}. (Someone else's bin)")
424                        self.agent.exploration_bin = None
425                        self.agent.where = None
426                        self.agent.current_path = None
427                        self.agent.is_busy = False
428                        self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(bin_position)
429                    else:
430                        # This truck keeps the claim and informs the other truck must yield the bin (decline-claim)
431                        confirm_msg = Message(to=str(msg.sender))
432                        confirm_msg.set_metadata("performative", "decline-claim")
433                        confirm_msg.body = f"{bin_position[0]},{bin_position[1]}"
434                        print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Warning other truck {msg.sender} to realise claim for bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}). (My bin)")
435                        await self.send(confirm_msg)
436                # Case 3: they don't want the same bin, just adds to non-accessible list to avoid wasting time
437                else:
438                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(bin_position)
439                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] apenas adicionou ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}) à lista de não acessiveis")
440
441        def evaluate_negotiation(self, my_cost, other_cost, my_fuel, other_fuel, my_capacity, other_capacity, my_id, other_id):
442            """
443            Deterministic logic to decide which truck should handle the collection based on capacity, cost, fuel and ID.
444
445            Args:
446                my_cost (int): Cost for self to reach the bin.      
447                other_cost (int): Cost for the peer truck to reach the bin.         
448                my_fuel (int): Current fuel of self.        
449                other_fuel (int): Current fuel of the peer truck.       
450                my_capacity (int): Available capacity of self.      
451                other_capacity (int): Available capacity of the peer truck.         
452                my_id (str): JID of self.       
453                other_id (str): JID of the peer truck.
454            
455            Returns:
456                bool: True if the *other* truck wins the negotiation (meaning self should yield), False otherwise.
457            """
458            print(f"[{self.agent.jid}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Negotiation details:")
459            print(f"  My cost: {my_cost}, Other cost: {other_cost}")
460            print(f"  My fuel: {my_fuel}, Other fuel: {other_fuel}")
461            print(f"  My capacity: {my_capacity}, Other capacity: {other_capacity}")
462            print(f"  My ID: {my_id}, Other ID: {other_id}")
463
464            # Priority 1: Truck with higher available capacity
465            if my_capacity > other_capacity:
466                print("[Decision] I have higher capacity.")
467                return False
468            elif my_capacity < other_capacity:
469                print("[Decision] Other has higher capacity.")
470                return True
471
472            # Priority 2: Truck with lower cost
473            if my_cost < other_cost:
474                print("[Decision] I have lower cost.")
475                return False
476            elif my_cost > other_cost:
477                print("[Decision] Other has lower cost.")
478                return True
479
480            # Priority 3: Truck with more fuel
481            if my_fuel > other_fuel:
482                print("[Decision] I have more fuel.")
483                return False
484            elif my_fuel < other_fuel:
485                print("[Decision] Other has more fuel.")
486                return True
487
488            # Priority 4: Deterministic tie-breaker by ID
489            if str(my_id) < str(other_id):
490                print("[Decision] I win by ID.")
491                return False
492            else:
493                print("[Decision] Other wins by ID.")
494                return True

Handles incoming 'claim-bin' messages from peers to prevent redundant collections.

497    class ReceiveAllocatationBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
498        """Handles incoming 'allocate-task' messages, taking over collections from failing or incapable peer trucks."""
499        async def run(self):
500            """Checks if capable of handling the allocated task and attempts to claim it."""
501            msg = await self.receive(timeout = 1)
502            if msg and msg.metadata.get("performative") == "allocate-task":
503                bin_pos = tuple(map(int, msg.body.split(","))) # problematic bin position
504                bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(bin_pos)

506                # Check waste type compatibility

590                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
591                    self.agent.where = None
592                    self.agent.current_path = None
593                    self.agent.is_busy = False
594                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Released bin at ({bin_position[1]},{bin_position[0]}) after decline-claim.")
595                self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(bin_position)

class TruckAgent.MoveToBehaviour(spade.behaviour.CyclicBehaviour): 
665    class MoveToBehaviour(CyclicBehaviour):
666        """Handles the physical movement of the truck along its planned path."""
667        async def run(self):
668            """Moves the truck one step along the path, consumes fuel, and handles environmental changes."""
669            # in each iteration, checks truck state
670            if self.agent.changes == True: # if changed, meaning environment updated somehow, checks if route needs changing
671                await self.receive_environment_update()
672            elif self.agent.is_broken == True: # if broken down
673                await self.broke_down()
674            else: # if not broken and environment didn't change
675                if self.agent.current_path != None:
676                    if self.agent.current_path == None:
677                        return
678                    path = self.agent.current_path
679                    if len(self.agent.current_path) != 1:
680                        curr_node_name = path[0] # truck moves from node to node
681                        next_node_name = path[1]
682                        next_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(next_node_name)
683                        self.agent.environment.move_truck(self, next_pos)
684                        edge_data = self.agent.environment.g.get_edge_data(curr_node_name, next_node_name)
685                        w_edge = edge_data["weight"] # consumes fuel
686                        self.agent.fuel -= w_edge
687                        self.agent.total_fuel += w_edge
688                        self.agent.total_distance += 1
689                        await asyncio.sleep(w_edge) # simulates physical travel time
690                        if self.agent.current_path != None and len(self.agent.current_path) != 1 and next_node_name == self.agent.current_path[1]:
691                            self.agent.current_path = self.agent.current_path[1:] # cuts the node representing where the truck just left
692                            print("cut path")
693                    else:
694                        print("Chegou ao destino") # if path has only 1 node
695                        if self.agent.where == 'bin': # if destination is a bin
696                            print("vai coletar lixo?")
697                            await self.collect_waste() # collects waste
698                            self.agent.current_path = None
699                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
700                            self.agent.where = None
701                            self.agent.is_busy = False
702                        elif self.agent.where == 'central': # if destination is central
703                            print("vai dar refill?")
704                            await self.refill()
705                            self.agent.current_path = None
706                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
707                            self.agent.where = None
708                            self.agent.is_busy = False
709        
710        async def receive_environment_update(self):
711            """Handles changes in the environment (e.g., traffic or roadblocks)."""
712            # Reset change flag
713            self.agent.changes = False
714
715            # Checks if previously inaccessible bins now have a path
716            for bin_pos in list(self.agent.no_path):
717                try:
718                    _, p = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin_pos)
719                    self.agent.no_path.remove(bin_pos)
720                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.remove(bin_pos)
721                except Exception:
722                    pass  # still no path
723
724            # Recalculates current path with updated traffic
725            if hasattr(self.agent, "current_target") and self.agent.current_target is not None:
726                try:
727                    _, new_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(self.agent.current_target)
728                    self.agent.current_path = new_path
729                except Exception:
730                    pass  # if fails, keeps old path
731
732                    
733                    # Check if truck's current path is still valid
734                    if self.agent.current_path != None: # current_path is the truck's path in the graph (a list of nodes)
735                        path = self.agent.current_path
736                        self.agent.current_path = None
737                        final_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(path[-1]) # path[-1] is the last node (the bin)
738                        try: # tries to recalculate path to destination
739                            _, new_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(final_pos) # if successful, replaces old path
740                            self.agent.current_path = new_path
741                        except Exception as e: # if path to destination no longer exists
742                                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Mudanças na estrada. Já não exite caminho para o bin em ({final_pos[1]},{final_pos[0]})")
743                                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
744                                    self.agent.where = None
745                                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(final_pos)
746                                    self.agent.no_path.append(final_pos)
747                                    self.agent.current_path = None
748                                    self.agent.is_busy = False
749                                    # Now we must tell the bin I am not coming
750                                    await self.warn_bin(final_pos)
751        
752        async def warn_bin(self, pos):
753            """
754            Sends a 'problem' message to the target bin when the path is lost due to environment changes.
755            
756            Args:
757                pos (tuple): Position of the bin to warn (row, col).
758            """
759            warn_msg = Message()
760            warn_msg.set_metadata("performative", "problem")
761            bin = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(pos)
762            warn_msg.to = str(bin.jid)
763            await self.send(warn_msg)
764            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Can't go to bin ({bin.position[1]},{bin.position[0]}). Bin warned.")
765
766        async def collect_waste(self):
767            """Simulates waste collection, updating truck load and bin waste level."""
768            bin_at_position = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(self.agent.position)
769            if bin_at_position:
770                load_to_collect = min(bin_at_position.current_waste, self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load)
771                self.agent.load += load_to_collect
772                self.agent.collected_waste += load_to_collect
773                bin_at_position.current_waste -= load_to_collect
774                bin_at_position.is_waiting_for_truck = False
775                
776                # Ensure the bin knows this is an exploration collection if it wasn't by CFP
777                if bin_at_position.last_collection_type != 'cfp':
778                    bin_at_position.last_collection_type = 'autonomous'
779                
780                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Truck collected {load_to_collect} waste. Current load: {self.agent.load}/{self.agent.max_load}.")
781                await self.send_release_message(bin_at_position.position)
782            else:
783                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] No bin found at the current position.")
784                
785        async def refill(self):
786            """Simulates refuelling and unloading the waste load at the central station."""
787            self.agent.fuel = self.agent.max_fuel  # Simulates refueling
788            self.agent.load = 0  # Simulates waste unloading
789            await asyncio.sleep(5)
790            self.agent.is_busy = False
791            self.agent.emergency = False # becomes ready for new tasks
792            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Refilled and unloaded at central.")
793
794        async def broke_down(self):
795            """ Handles the truck breaking down, releasing the bin and entering a waiting state."""
796            if (self.agent.is_broken):  
797                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] is broken")   
798                if self.agent.current_path != None:   
799                    bin_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(self.agent.current_path[-1])
800                    await self.send_release_message(bin_pos)
801                    if (self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.emergency and self.agent.exploration_bin != None):
802                        print("Estava busy,  alocar outros trucks")
803                        await self.warn_bin(bin_pos)
804                        await self.alocate_others_trucks(bin_pos)
805                        
806                self.agent.exploration_bin = None

async def run(self): 
667        async def run(self):
668            """Moves the truck one step along the path, consumes fuel, and handles environmental changes."""
669            # in each iteration, checks truck state
670            if self.agent.changes == True: # if changed, meaning environment updated somehow, checks if route needs changing
671                await self.receive_environment_update()
672            elif self.agent.is_broken == True: # if broken down
673                await self.broke_down()
674            else: # if not broken and environment didn't change
675                if self.agent.current_path != None:
676                    if self.agent.current_path == None:
677                        return
678                    path = self.agent.current_path
679                    if len(self.agent.current_path) != 1:
680                        curr_node_name = path[0] # truck moves from node to node
681                        next_node_name = path[1]
682                        next_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(next_node_name)
683                        self.agent.environment.move_truck(self, next_pos)
684                        edge_data = self.agent.environment.g.get_edge_data(curr_node_name, next_node_name)
685                        w_edge = edge_data["weight"] # consumes fuel
686                        self.agent.fuel -= w_edge
687                        self.agent.total_fuel += w_edge
688                        self.agent.total_distance += 1
689                        await asyncio.sleep(w_edge) # simulates physical travel time
690                        if self.agent.current_path != None and len(self.agent.current_path) != 1 and next_node_name == self.agent.current_path[1]:
691                            self.agent.current_path = self.agent.current_path[1:] # cuts the node representing where the truck just left
692                            print("cut path")
693                    else:
694                        print("Chegou ao destino") # if path has only 1 node
695                        if self.agent.where == 'bin': # if destination is a bin
696                            print("vai coletar lixo?")
697                            await self.collect_waste() # collects waste
698                            self.agent.current_path = None
699                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
700                            self.agent.where = None
701                            self.agent.is_busy = False
702                        elif self.agent.where == 'central': # if destination is central
703                            print("vai dar refill?")
704                            await self.refill()
705                            self.agent.current_path = None
706                            self.agent.exploration_bin = None
707                            self.agent.where = None
708                            self.agent.is_busy = False

Moves the truck one step along the path, consumes fuel, and handles environmental changes.

async def receive_environment_update(self): 
710        async def receive_environment_update(self):
711            """Handles changes in the environment (e.g., traffic or roadblocks)."""
712            # Reset change flag
713            self.agent.changes = False
714
715            # Checks if previously inaccessible bins now have a path
716            for bin_pos in list(self.agent.no_path):
717                try:
718                    _, p = self.agent.get_shortest_path(bin_pos)
719                    self.agent.no_path.remove(bin_pos)
720                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.remove(bin_pos)
721                except Exception:
722                    pass  # still no path
723
724            # Recalculates current path with updated traffic
725            if hasattr(self.agent, "current_target") and self.agent.current_target is not None:
726                try:
727                    _, new_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(self.agent.current_target)
728                    self.agent.current_path = new_path
729                except Exception:
730                    pass  # if fails, keeps old path
731
732                    
733                    # Check if truck's current path is still valid
734                    if self.agent.current_path != None: # current_path is the truck's path in the graph (a list of nodes)
735                        path = self.agent.current_path
736                        self.agent.current_path = None
737                        final_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(path[-1]) # path[-1] is the last node (the bin)
738                        try: # tries to recalculate path to destination
739                            _, new_path = self.agent.get_shortest_path(final_pos) # if successful, replaces old path
740                            self.agent.current_path = new_path
741                        except Exception as e: # if path to destination no longer exists
742                                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Mudanças na estrada. Já não exite caminho para o bin em ({final_pos[1]},{final_pos[0]})")
743                                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
744                                    self.agent.where = None
745                                    self.agent.not_accessible_bins.append(final_pos)
746                                    self.agent.no_path.append(final_pos)
747                                    self.agent.current_path = None
748                                    self.agent.is_busy = False
749                                    # Now we must tell the bin I am not coming
750                                    await self.warn_bin(final_pos)

async def collect_waste(self): 
766        async def collect_waste(self):
767            """Simulates waste collection, updating truck load and bin waste level."""
768            bin_at_position = self.agent.environment.get_bin_at_position(self.agent.position)
769            if bin_at_position:
770                load_to_collect = min(bin_at_position.current_waste, self.agent.max_load - self.agent.load)
771                self.agent.load += load_to_collect
772                self.agent.collected_waste += load_to_collect
773                bin_at_position.current_waste -= load_to_collect
774                bin_at_position.is_waiting_for_truck = False
775                
776                # Ensure the bin knows this is an exploration collection if it wasn't by CFP
777                if bin_at_position.last_collection_type != 'cfp':
778                    bin_at_position.last_collection_type = 'autonomous'
779                
780                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Truck collected {load_to_collect} waste. Current load: {self.agent.load}/{self.agent.max_load}.")
781                await self.send_release_message(bin_at_position.position)
782            else:
783                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] No bin found at the current position.")

785        async def refill(self):
786            """Simulates refuelling and unloading the waste load at the central station."""

792            print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] Refilled and unloaded at central.")

794        async def broke_down(self):
795            """ Handles the truck breaking down, releasing the bin and entering a waiting state."""
796            if (self.agent.is_broken):  
797                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] is broken")   
798                if self.agent.current_path != None:   
799                    bin_pos = self.agent.environment.get_pos_from_node_name(self.agent.current_path[-1])

802                        print("Estava busy,  alocar outros trucks")
803                        await self.warn_bin(bin_pos)

805                        
806                self.agent.exploration_bin = None

815                print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] normal functioning started") # back to normal
816                
817                self.agent.emergency = False
818                self.agent.is_broken = False
819                self.agent.is_busy = False

class TruckAgent.Help(spade.behaviour.CyclicBehaviour): 
853    class Help(CyclicBehaviour):
854        """ Safety mechanism to detect if the truck is stuck or blocked.
855        
856        If the truck is busy but stationary for too long (5s), it releases the bin, 
857        sends a warning to peer trucks, and becomes available again.
858        """
859        async def run(self):      
860            """Monitors truck position over time and triggers alert if the truck is blocked while busy."""                                                              
861            # Help only acts if truck is busy and not broken...
862            if self.agent.is_busy and not self.agent.is_broken:
863                start_pos = self.agent.position
864                start_time = self.agent.environment.timer()
865
866                # Waits 5 time units (simulates periodic monitoring)
867                await asyncio.sleep(5)
868                new_time = self.agent.environment.timer()
869
870                # If enough time passed and truck didn't move -> blocked
871                if new_time - start_time >= 5 and self.agent.position == start_pos:
872                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] parece estar preso. Ativando HELP...")
873
874                    # If associated with a bin, notifies and releases
875                    if self.agent.exploration_bin is not None:
876                        await self.warn_bin(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
877                        await self.send_release_message(self.agent.exploration_bin.position)
878                        print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] liberou o bin e enviou alerta.")
879
880                    # Reset dos estados principais
881                    self.agent.is_busy = False
882                    self.agent.current_path = None
883                    self.agent.exploration_bin = None
884                    self.agent.where = None
885
886                    print(f"[{self.agent.name}] [{self.agent.truck_type}] ready for new tasks after HELP.")
887
